# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000–$380,000 USD OTE | Reports to Partnerships / GTM leadership (partner-facing architecture context) |

## JD Complement
Anthropic’s partner motion sits at the intersection of a frontier AI product company and enterprise deployment reality. The role is not simply about technical enablement: it likely exists to make Claude repeatable to sell, deploy, govern,
and expand through third parties.

The operating tension is speed versus control. Anthropic needs partners to multiply customer reach and implementation capacity without allowing delivery quality, security posture, product feedback, or its safety positioning to fragment
across the ecosystem.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic is a San Francisco-headquartered AI public benefit corporation founded in 2021. Its stated mission centers on reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.

Its archetype is a product-led frontier-AI company becoming a platform-led and partner-enabled enterprise business. Claude is the commercial product surface, while the company’s safety orientation remains part of its market identity rather
than a separate research-only narrative.

The dominant commercial challenge is converting model capability into durable enterprise adoption. That requires more than direct selling: customers need deployment patterns, change-management support, governance confidence, technical
integration, and use-case evidence.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Anthropic presents Claude as an AI product for complex problem-solving, including analysis, coding, writing, and business workflows. Its enterprise posture explicitly combines business-team and developer needs with security and compliance
considerations.

The company’s enterprise materials frame adoption as a progression from technical setup through change management, launch, and broader organizational use. This signals that implementation quality and user adoption are strategic commercial
concerns, not downstream services tasks.

The operating-model pressure is to standardize what can be repeated through partners while retaining direct feedback loops to product and engineering. As partner coverage grows, decision rights around architecture guidance, escalations,
solution patterns, and field feedback become more consequential.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
Daniela Amodei is a co-founder and president.

For a partner-facing architecture leader, the meaningful stakeholder map spans Partnerships, Sales, Product, Engineering, enterprise customer teams, and partner technical leaders. The role must translate among commercial urgency, customer
architecture constraints, product limits, and Anthropic’s safety commitments.

The highest-value internal relationships are likely the ones that turn recurring partner friction into reusable enablement, clearer product requirements, and sharper rules for when Anthropic joins a strategic technical close directly.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Claude is positioned as an AI assistant for problem-solving across knowledge work and software-oriented tasks. Anthropic’s enterprise offering emphasizes security, compliance, and deployment for both business users and developers.

Anthropic provides enterprise deployment guidance covering technical setup, organizational launch, and adoption. That is a signal that architecture work must encompass identity, controls, workflow design, user enablement, and operating
change rather than stopping at an API integration.

The company’s stated focus on reliability, interpretability, and steerability creates a practical architecture lens: solution patterns need to support appropriate controls and trustworthy use, not merely demonstrate model output quality.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Anthropic publicly describes a network of cloud, technology, and services partners focused on solving customer AI challenges. This is material partnership DNA, not a peripheral referral channel.

The ecosystem model creates leverage because partners can bring customer access, implementation capacity, industry context, and ongoing delivery presence. It also raises the need for consistent technical qualification and clear boundaries
between partner-owned delivery and Anthropic-led intervention.

The strongest partner motion will likely combine:
- Joint solution patterns that partners can adapt across accounts and industries.
- Technical enablement that makes partner teams independently credible with Claude.
- Co-sell support for high-stakes opportunities where architecture influences the commercial outcome.
- Structured product feedback from real deployments rather than isolated field anecdotes.
- Repeatable deployment guidance that protects enterprise quality as ecosystem volume rises.

## Recent Events & Urgency
Anthropic’s current public materials show a clear enterprise-adoption emphasis: Claude Enterprise resources cover deployment and organizational change, while the partner network spans cloud, technology, and services firms.

That combination creates urgency to industrialize partner execution. The company needs ecosystem scale without turning every deployment into a bespoke Anthropic engagement or allowing partner implementations to diverge from product,
security, and adoption expectations.

Competitive pressure in enterprise AI is increasingly shaped by who can move from evaluation to governed production use. For Anthropic, partner-delivered implementation quality can materially affect product adoption, expansion, and market
perception.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Partner-led enterprise AI architecture and technical go-to-market.
- Scaling enablement from individual experts into repeatable partner programs.
- Translating platform capabilities into deployable business solutions.
- Building reusable reference architectures, technical playbooks, and escalation paths.
- Managing the handoff between direct technical teams and partner-owned delivery.
- Converting field feedback into prioritized product and engineering input.
- Balancing adoption velocity with security, governance, and responsible-AI requirements.
- Coaching technical customer-facing teams through ambiguity and rapid product evolution.

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- Anthropic’s ecosystem spans cloud, technology, and services partners rather than a narrow resale channel.
- Claude Enterprise deployment guidance recognizes that adoption requires both technical setup and organizational change.
- The interesting scaling problem is making partner-delivered Claude implementations consistent without making every engagement bespoke.
- The role sits where partner strategy, technical close, customer architecture, and product feedback meet.
- Anthropic’s reliability and steerability positioning makes implementation discipline part of the commercial story.
- A useful discussion point is how to package repeatable solution patterns while preserving room for industry-specific partner expertise.

## Do Not Use As Proof
The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only. Candidate claims must come from the governed resume and proof graph.

Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
    Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.

Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD
